The Schwab analytics suite in ~/repos/Brokers (branch Surface_Local_Branch) is built and committed.

**Notebooks** (`notebooks/schwab/01..14` + data_summary): generated by `scripts/schwab/build_notebooks.py`
(the `.ipynb` are gitignored build artifacts; the builder is the source of truth). All host-safe (pure
pandas + local CSV/JSON, no broker import). Pinned to the **`brokers-py314`** Jupyter kernel (registered
via `python -m ipykernel install --user --name brokers-py314`; host interp = C:\Python314 with
pandas/numpy/matplotlib/seaborn/mplfinance/plotly/statsmodels/scipy -- see notebooks/schwab/requirements.txt).
Key ones: 02 history (multi-symbol candles, plotly, tick/volume bars, forward curve+carry-slope+OI,
currencies, shares/position), 03 options greeks+walls, 07/08/14 efficient frontier, 11 alerts, 12 seasonality
(OLS+HAC, exponential regression, kruskal/harmonic consensus), 13 futures gallery (default light; full =
ROOTS=list(FUTURES)+SHOW_CONTRACT_MONTHS=True). SETUP reloads nb_analytics (importlib.reload) so a warm
kernel never throws the stale-import ImportError; re-run the first cell to self-heal.

**Alerts** (`scripts/schwab/run_alerts.py`, host-safe): quant-pivot Nth-band breach (default 4h band>=3) AND
percent-spike (`--spike-pct/--spike-min`). Channels: Windows toast (winotify), Telegram
(broker_platform.alerts.dispatcher -> TelegramBackend, .env TELEGRAM_*), SMS text (free email-to-SMS gateway,
.env SMS_*/SMTP_* -- SMTP_EMAIL/SMTP_PASSWORD still BLANK so SMS not live until a Gmail app password is added;
.env.secrets is read first). De-dup with `--dedup`/`--reset-per-period`/`--per-alert`. Scheduled tasks:
`Brokers_Schwab_Alerts` (4h, currencies+XOM+CL/SI/GC, run_alerts_targeted.bat) and `Brokers_Schwab_Spike_Alerts`
(5m, 0.25% currency spike, run_alerts_spike.bat); install via install_alerts_task.ps1.

**Real-time ticks**: `scripts/schwab/stream_ticks.py` (Docker; schwab-py StreamClient async -- correct
API is `level_one_futures_add`/`level_one_equity_add` + `add_level_one_*_handler` + `handle_message`,
NOT `level_one_futures`) records every level-one update to `data/schwab/ticks/<ROOT>.csv`. Three fixes
(commit 8fe1f42): (1) resolve futures roots to FRONT-MONTH dated contracts (/6E -> /6EM26) from the
latest futures_curve snapshot -- continuous roots only return a one-shot snapshot; (2) DELTA-merge
handler -- Schwab sends only changed fields per update, so merge into per-symbol state and record on any
change instead of dropping updates lacking LAST_PRICE; (3) write under the ROOT name via native->root
map so 02 finds ticks/6E.csv. Snapshot capture is verified (6E last/bid/ask). ONGOING-tick streaming is
NOT yet validated: every test fell on **Memorial Day 2026-05-25** (US market holiday) so BOTH equities
(XOM/SPY/AAPL) and futures returned only the initial snapshot, 0 ongoing -- confirming it's a closed
market, not a code bug. The script now prints a `[session]` heads-up on weekends/holidays/maintenance.
Re-validate ongoing ticks on a normal weekday session via `stream_ticks.bat`. `nb_analytics.tick_bars`
builds TRUE N-tick bars; 02 has a true-144-tick cell.

**No window/focus interruptions (2026-05-26)**: the per-minute keep-alive (Brokers_Schwab_Intraday) and the
5-min spike + 4h QP alert tasks used to launch powershell/.bat directly, flashing a console + stealing typing
focus each interval. Now ALL run windowless via wscript + a window-mode-0 VBScript: `_keepalive_hidden.vbs`
(keep-alive) and `_run_hidden.vbs` (generic hidden bat-runner, used by both alert tasks). Toasts/Telegram/SMS
still fire (tasks stay /IT interactive); only the window is suppressed. Re-register via install_intraday_tasks.ps1
+ install_alerts_task.ps1. The visible loop window only appears when the loop is actually down.

**Data-freshness watchdog + CWD fix + Docker-down silent-failure (2026-05-28):** root-caused why the loop
printed "no usable 1m data" for all 11 watch symbols overnight. TWO independent bugs: (1) CWD bug,
`nb_analytics.data_dir()` resolved data/schwab relative to `Path.cwd()`; the scheduled-task launch (wscript
-> launch_intraday_loop.ps1 -> Start-Process, no working dir) inherits CWD=System32, so it found nothing
even though the 1m CSVs have 30k+ rows. FIXED: data_dir() now falls back to `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
/data/schwab` (CWD-independent, works host + Docker /app), and run_intraday_loop.ps1 now `Set-Location $repo`
at startup. (2) Docker Desktop was DOWN, pull_intraday.ps1 runs the pull in Docker and swallows stderr with
`2>$null`, so pulls wrote NOTHING (data frozen at 16:10 UTC 05-27) while the loop kept spinning silently.
NEW host-safe script `scripts/schwab/data_freshness_watchdog.py`: watches the newest 1m bar across the watch
set and escalates a Telegram alert WARN@5m -> ERROR@1h -> CRITICAL@4h -> then STOPS (each tier once per stale
episode, [OK] note on recovery). Session-gated (mirrors pull_intraday In-FuturesSession/In-EquitySession) so it
stays quiet overnight/weekends + the daily 17:00-18:00 ET halt. Flags: `--status`, `--test-telegram`, `--tiers
5,60,240`, `--telegram/--notify/--sms`, `--no-session-gate`, `--no-recovery`, `--state`. Wired into
run_intraday_loop.ps1 each minute via knobs `$RunFreshnessWatchdog/$FreshnessTiersMin/$FreshnessPy`. TELEGRAM
VERIFIED LIVE via `--test-telegram` (real token 46 chars in .env.secrets, chat_id 861774748; load_env_creds
reads .env.secrets FIRST and never overwrites, so the real token beats the 21-char placeholder in .env).
COMPLETED 2026-05-28 (session 2): Docker Desktop started (engine 29.3.1; token was valid, ~4.3d old < ~7d
refresh limit, so the outage was purely Docker down). Loop launched manually (PID 66520) and data verified
flowing (fresh 1m bars for all 11 symbols). NEW always-on scheduled task `Brokers_Schwab_Freshness` (every
5 min, windowless via `_run_hidden.vbs` -> new `scripts/schwab/run_freshness_watchdog.bat`, host python,
`--telegram --notify`) monitors data INDEPENDENTLY of whether the loop window is open; shares the default
state file with the in-loop call so escalation never double-fires. COMMITTED as `28da2e1` on Surface_Local_Branch
(4 files: nb_analytics.py, run_intraday_loop.ps1, data_freshness_watchdog.py, run_freshness_watchdog.bat; .env
and data files deliberately excluded). Roadmap: [[2026-05-28_000041_schwab-intraday-autorun-stop]].

**Intraday loop**: launch via `launch_intraday_loop.bat` / `.ps1` (keep-alive window; relaunches if closed).
run_intraday_loop.ps1 Tees runs to data/schwab/logs/intraday_<date>.log with **24h retention** (mirrors
ServiceWatchdog's age-based cleanup). As of 2026-05-25 it ALSO runs the QP alert each minute on the
freshly-pulled 1m data (host python, run_alerts.py), **once per timeframe in `$QpTimeframes` (default 1h + 4h)**.
CORRECTED DESIGN (user flagged the mismatch): each timeframe is evaluated against its OWN-timeframe QP bands
and re-arms on its OWN period boundary via `--reset-per-period` -- the 1h alert uses 1h levels and re-notifies
each new clock hour, the 4h alert uses 4h levels and re-notifies each new 4h block. (Resetting 4h bands hourly
was wrong: 4h bands don't move within the hour, so the reset cadence MUST equal the timeframe.) Per-timeframe
state files `_alert_state_loop_<tf>.json`, independent of each other and of the 4h Brokers_Schwab_Alerts task.
Config knobs at the top: `$RunQpAlerts/$QpSymbols/$QpBand/$QpTimeframes/$QpNotify/$QpTelegram/$QpSms`. The
`--reset-period <tf>` flag in run_alerts.py still exists as an ADVANCED override (re-arm on a different cadence
than the pivot tf) but the loop does NOT use it -- the timeframe drives the period.

**QP levels table (CSV) + ASCII board**: `scripts/schwab/qp_levels_table.py` (host-safe) writes one row per
(symbol, timeframe) with marker (^/v/=), status (ABOVE Hk/BELOW Lk/INSIDE), nearest bracketing levels
(below_level/below_value/above_level/above_value), the full H1..H10/L1..L10 ladder, close, band, fit. Default
symbols = loop watch-set UNIONED with holdings; `--symbols/--timeframes` to override. `--monitor` prints an
ASCII board per (symbol,tf): marker + BELOW level + position gauge `[----*----]` (price between bracketing
levels) + ABOVE level + close + status; `--board` limits the printed board to a subset (CSV keeps all);
`--no-snapshot` refreshes only the latest CSV. Output: stable `data/schwab/qp_levels_latest.csv` (the CLICKABLE
file) + timestamped `data/schwab/qp_levels/qp_levels_<ts>.csv`. The intraday loop now refreshes the clickable
CSV (all symbols) AND prints the ASCII board (watch set) EVERY poll; a full timestamped snapshot is kept hourly.
Per-poll full table ~5.7s (watch-set ~2.1s). LIVE CLI TRACKER: `--watch SECS` re-computes + reprints the
board every SECS (clears screen); `--view-only` displays without writing any CSV (so a watch-set view never
clobbers the full latest CSV). `scripts/schwab/qp_board.bat` launches it (watch set, 1h+4h, --watch 60); a
machine-local desktop launcher `%USERPROFILE%\Desktop\Schwab QP Board.bat` (NOT committed) calls that bat. Confirmed the auto-pull self-heals gaps (pull_history resumes from
the last stored bar within the interval depth: 1m ~45d, 5m ~205d). The QP band
EQUATION is documented in notebook 11_alerts (and concisely in 02): with current period open O and trailing-N
per-period up/down moves up_i=100*(H_i-O_i)/C_i, dn_i=100*|O_i-L_i|/C_i, then H_k=O*(1+(mu_up+(k-1)*sd_up)/100),
L_k=O*(1-(mu_dn+(k-1)*sd_dn)/100); pivot=O; band k uses multiplier (k-1) so H1=avg move, each band adds 1 sigma.

**Data limits found this session (do not re-attempt):** Schwab serves NO `/VX` (use VIXY/VXX), NO `/DX`
(use UUP/UDN), NO futures option chains (/ES,/GC,/CL,/6E all HTTP 400), and NO per-trade tick data (only 1m
OHLCV) -- so true 144/100k-tick charts are impossible; volume bars are the realizable substitute. Futures
quotes DO carry `openInterest`+`totalVolume`. The 4 big currency IMM months are H/M/U/Z (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec).

**Bug fixed this session:** compute_quant_pivots rounded band levels to 4 decimals, collapsing all bands for
sub-$1 instruments (6J/6A) -> mislabels; fixed by classifying on full precision + significant-figure display
(`_sig`) in broker_platform/thinkscript/indicators.py.

**02_get_history data-integrity hardening (2026-05-25, commit 8b12cbe):** Added a "three INDEPENDENT
cross-checks" section -- (1) raw-file provenance (path/size/sha256/mtime + literal first/last rows),
(2) cross-timeframe reconciliation (1m last-of-day vs the independent daily store; GC: 30 dates, median
|diff| 0.079%), (3) invariants on derived bars (volume conserved exactly, OHLC bounded, tick_bars count ==
ceil(ticks/N), SMA pandas==numpy). The SMA set is now ADAPTIVE: SMA_n draws only if len(bars)>=n AND >=50%
of the window has a value, else dropped with a printed reason (no fake SMA365 on thin data). Tick-bar cell
now requires >=2 full 144-tick bars before plotting (else explains the closed-market reason instead of
drawing 1 garbage candle). Added all-7-currency x all-timeframe coverage grid + explicit 1m & 4h candles,
a rich contango/backwardation markdown, and **QP levels per candle** (draw_candles overlays ST_QuantPivots
pivot + H1..Hn/L1..Ln, anchored one TF up). Daily candle density verified correct: ~21 trading days/month
(not 30 calendar). Executed 02 end-to-end: 62 cells, 0 errors. All new 02 cells are wrapped in
per-symbol/per-file try/except with column+empty guards so one bad file warns and continues instead of
aborting the cell. The host-safe carve-out (notebooks + nb_analytics/nb_seasonality/portfolio_opt/
run_alerts import NO broker SDK and run on the brokers-py314 kernel; stream_ticks.py + pulls + auth need
Docker) is now documented in ~/.claude/agents/broker-isolation-enforcer.md. (No custom skills exist under
~/.claude/skills.)
